title: Constitution de la République algérienne démocratique et populaire (révision promulguée par décret présidentiel n° 20-442)
issuer: Secrétariat général du Gouvernement, Journal officiel de la République algérienne démocratique et populaire
source_locator: Journal officiel n° 82 du 30 décembre 2020, p. 4-49 (PDF pages 4-49), texte annexé au décret présidentiel n° 20-442
verification_note: Official JORADP French edition; PDF pages 4-49 were re-extracted with pdftotext 4.00 using UTF-8 and compared with this file. The title, Article 1er, Articles 2, 30, 91, 224 and 225, and a phrase from the final oath were checked against the fresh text-layer extraction; selected excerpts align with minor extraction differences. Gazette headers and printer footer are excluded. This is not a visual audit of every page or a legal-status review. Later revisions and current force remain unverified.
rights_verification_note: The source identifies the French edition as an official translation; only the constitutional legal text is included, not the Gazette issue, cover, index, or other materials. Reuse classification follows the statutory exception for official translations of legal texts in Article 11 of Ordinance 03-05; this is a documented technical basis, not a legal opinion.
legal_status_verification_note: The 2020 text is an official historical publication, but later amendments, replacement, and current force have not been independently verified.
